crypto.name: Polymarket
crypto.note: Deepest books in the category by a distance, and the only venue where election and macro markets clear size without moving.

crypto.name: Limitless
crypto.note: Hourly crypto-price markets with an AMM behind them — thin on anything that is not BTC or ETH.

crypto.name: Drift BET
crypto.note: Fast and cheap because it is Solana, and tied to the same account as the perps exchange.

crypto.name: Overtime
crypto.note: Sports-first parimutuel markets. Effective spread is wide, but no counterparty and no account.

crypto.name: Myriad
crypto.note: Culture and crypto-media markets, small size. Interesting questions, shallow books.

fiat.name: Kalshi
fiat.note: The regulated benchmark: a real exchange with a real regulator, and the only place a US resident can trade event contracts without ambiguity.

fiat.name: Polymarket US
fiat.note: The licensed US venue running on the acquired QCX seat. Same interface, different rails, fewer markets so far.

fiat.name: Robinhood Prediction
fiat.note: Cheapest per-contract cost in the category, wrapped in a broker app most people already have. Market list is curated, not complete.

fiat.name: IBKR ForecastEx
fiat.note: Economics and climate contracts inside a professional platform. Pays interest on held positions, which nothing else does.

fiat.name: PredictIt
fiat.note: The academic original. Position caps and double fees make it the most expensive way to be right.
